lines.text: Can I ask you something strange?
lines.speaker: near

lines.text: When you think, who is talking?
lines.speaker: near

lines.text: Then there are two of you.
lines.speaker: near

lines.text: Every night, one of them is scared.
lines.speaker: far

lines.text: Neither. You are the one who noticed.
lines.speaker: far

lines.text: Tonight, when the voice starts, do not argue. Listen.
lines.speaker: near
